title: AI Models Integration - View 3 Separate Provider Cards
description: Verify that the Integrations page shows 3 separate AI provider cards: OpenAI, Gemini, and OpenRouter

steps.description: OpenAI card is visible with icon 🤖
Google Gemini card is visible with icon ✨
OpenRouter card is visible with icon ⚡

title: AI Models Category Tab Filter
description: Verify that the AI Models category tab exists and filters to show only the 3 AI provider cards

steps.description: AI Models tab is visible in category filter
Only 3 cards are displayed: OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter
Other integration cards (Google Calendar, Stripe, etc) are not visible

title: Configure OpenAI with API Key and Model Selection
description: Test OpenAI configuration including API key input, model selection from dropdown, and custom model support

steps.description: Configuration dialog opens with title 'Configure OpenAI'
API Key password field is present
Model dropdown shows official model names: gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4-turbo, etc
Select a model from dropdown (e.g., gpt-4o-mini)

title: OpenAI Feature Assignment Toggles
description: Verify that OpenAI configuration allows selecting which features (Voice Agent, Summarization, Analytics, Transcription) use OpenAI

steps.description: Voice Agent toggle switch is present
Knowledge Base Summarization toggle is present
Success message appears: 'OpenAI settings updated successfully!'

title: Configure Gemini with API Key and Model Selection
description: Test Gemini configuration with API key, official Gemini model selection (2.5-pro, 2.5-flash, etc), and feature assignment

steps.description: Click Gemini card in AI Models tab
Configuration dialog opens with title 'Configure Google Gemini'
Gemini API Key field is present
Model dropdown shows official Gemini models: gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.0-flash, etc
Toggle Knowledge Base Summarization ON for Gemini

title: Configure OpenRouter with Multi-Model Selection
description: Test OpenRouter configuration with API key, multi-provider model selection, and custom model support

steps.description: Model dropdown shows provider/model format: openai/gpt-4o, anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet, etc
Select 'Custom Model...' and enter custom provider/model
Custom model input accepts provider/model format

title: AI Provider Database Persistence
description: Verify that AI provider configurations (keys, models, feature assignments) are saved to database and persist across sessions

steps.description: Configure OpenAI with API key and feature assignments

title: Knowledge Base Summarization with Configured AI Provider
description: Test that Knowledge Base uses the configured AI provider (Gemini) for summarization and respects the model selection

steps.description: Configure Gemini as summarization provider with model gemini-2.5-flash
Navigate to Settings → AI Configuration → Knowledge Base
Set Max Depth to 3, Max Pages to 30
Summarization uses Gemini API (check server logs show 'Using AI provider for summarization: gemini Model: gemini-2.5-flash')
Knowledge source is saved to database

title: Mix and Match AI Providers for Different Features
description: Test configuring different AI providers for different features (e.g., OpenAI for voice, Gemini for summarization)

steps.description: Configure OpenAI: Toggle Voice Agent ON, Summarization OFF
Configure Gemini: Toggle Voice Agent OFF, Summarization ON

title: Custom Model Entry for Future Models
description: Verify that custom model entry works for all providers and accepts any model identifier for future model support

steps.description: Custom model name is saved to database

title: All Integrations Comprehensive Test
description: Test all integration cards including Calendar, Payment, Communication, AI Models, and Analytics

steps.description: All integration categories are visible: All, AI Models, Calendar, Payment, Communication, Analytics, Other
All integration cards show correct status badges
Each card can be clicked to open configuration dialog
